5.body: Hello there! I am making a coding language for Mistwarp, Turbowarp, and possibly PenguinMod. I am plaining to call it SillyScript. The goal of SillyScript is to make UI coding more like SwiftUI, adding built in function for cryptography, and a complier so you can add your own functions! This complies to HTML. I am plaining on releasing this on May 12.
